description: The person's templates (saved whole projects to start from), like Dinoctor's Templates page. action list (read-only), save (name: saves the project as it is now), open (id: replaces the open project with the template; one undo step brings it back), delete (id: for good, needs confirm: true after the person agrees). For .dino project files use open_project / save_project; for shot recipes use samples.

confirm.description: For delete: true only after the person agreed.

id.description: A template id from list (open, delete).

name: templates
